description: Request a free evaluation API key in-band. Keyd applies persistent per-client-IP and global daily issuance limits. The returned key's recall and optional write-sample terms are read from the authoritative key record. Pass it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on subsequent calls.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).

ref.description: Optional referral/channel tag for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).

name: service.request_eval_key
title: Request Evaluation Key
